title: Transactional outbox rows are marked delivered without any delivery and no SSE consumer exists

original_titles.title: Transactional outbox has no dispatcher; intents written but never delivered
Outbox dispatcher is dead code and delivers nothing
REALTIME module (SSE /v1/stream) not implemented; all updates are polling
Notifications module absent (no email invites, reminders, results or dispute mails)

problem: Submission and level paths insert app.outbox_events. evaluator.py dispatch_outbox selects undelivered rows and updates delivered_at/attempts but has no actual publish call. worker.py does not schedule dispatch_outbox. There is no /v1/stream SSE endpoint or notification consumer.
impact: Realtime intents are silently discarded. Participants discover stage changes, results and review updates only through polling; the outbox falsely records delivery, making the audit trail misleading.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Define typed outbox event schemas and delivery targets (SSE stream, email/notification, or webhooks). Never set delivered_at until at least one configured consumer acknowledges successful delivery.

Add a dispatcher job that claims rows with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, increments attempts, records last_error and uses per-event retry/backoff; dead-letter poison messages instead of silently dropping them.

Implement GET /v1/stream using text/event-stream, stable event ids, heartbeat, Last-Event-ID replay and per-user/event authorization. Do not broadcast GT or private team details to the wrong audience.
Wire frontend ConnectionIndicator and event handlers; use polling as a documented fallback and avoid duplicate state application using event ids/version numbers.
Add tests for delivery, disconnect/reconnect replay, duplicate delivery, permission isolation and retry/dead-letter outcomes.

acceptance_criteria: A row is marked delivered only after acknowledged delivery.
Every event type has an explicit consumer and replay policy.
Reconnect does not lose events or duplicate side effects.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
